title: tragopogon pratensis subsp. hayekii
intro: Tragopogon pratensis subsp. hayekii, commonly known as the hay fever weed or false dandelion, is a subspecies of the common dandelion plant native to Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and alleviating symptoms of hay fever and asthma. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to act as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Tragopogon pratensis subsp. hayekii include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
